blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — Local rice farming received a big modernization boost as the Department of Agriculture in Northern Mindanao (DA-10) officially commissioned a P68-million rice milling facility. Built for the provincial government under the Rice Competitiveness Enhancement Fund (RCEF) mechanization program, which is implemented by the DA’s Philippine Center for Postharvest Development and Mechanization, the facility, located in Barangay Sinabuagan, started operations last November 5. The facility is a multi-stage mill capable of processing two to three tons of palay per hour and four recirculating dryers that handle six tons per batch.
